prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: revised FACIAL ACTING study for the SELECTED Looksy mechanical scout. Input image 1 is the exact identity reference. Preserve its broad sculpted ivory head, long triangular nose ridge, two recessed brown eyes, movable graphite eyebrow plates, separate upper/lower eyelids, mouth seam, circular side bearings, ribbed neck, tapered torso, proportions and high-end theatrical CGI material finish. This character has been selected by the user; do not redesign him.
Create a polished landscape sheet of SIX large head-and-shoulder portraits in a two-by-three grid. Same scale and same basic camera side for all six. Entire head and neck visible with margins. Dark charcoal studio background, consistent warm soft key and cool rim.
The ACTING MUST BE CLEARLY DIFFERENT in each panel, readable at small size. Avoid repeating a pleasant neutral smile six times.
TOP LEFT, attentive neutral: level head, relaxed symmetrical brows, mouth seam closed, eyes directly attentive toward viewer.
TOP MIDDLE, curious: substantial but believable neck/head tilt, ONE eyebrow noticeably raised while the other stays low, one upper lid more open, gaze toward a point just above frame, mouth a tiny off-center questioning shape.
TOP RIGHT, focused working: chin lowered, pupils looking down toward a task, upper eyelids narrowed, eyebrow plates angled inward and downward, completely straight closed mouth, serious concentration without anger.
BOTTOM LEFT, concerned: inner ends of brows raised, visible asymmetry, worried eyes directed aside, small downturned mouth seam, neck slightly drawn back.
BOTTOM MIDDLE, pleased/success: unmistakably warm broad asymmetric smile, upper eyelids lowered softly into a happy squint, raised relaxed brows and a modest upward head angle. Clear satisfaction without a giant open mouth.
BOTTOM RIGHT, speaking: eyes engaged toward viewer, brows lifted to emphasize a point, jaw/mouth seam visibly open in a natural mid-speech shape with a dark recessed interior; no teeth or tongue detail needed, no huge cartoon mouth.
Expression comes from moving the existing brow plates, eyelids, pupils, mouth/jaw and neck, NOT changing the sculpted head shape or enlarging eyes. Rich physical ceramic/enamel, dark titanium and brass materials, believable eye reflections. No text, labels, props, camera/lens eyes, flat vector shading, new character features, neon, childlike baby proportions, or exaggerated rubber-face stretching. This is a concept acting sheet, not an actual facial rig or animated performance.
